exposure.needed: whether the operator builds the API documentation from the repository's /hack/api-docs tooling using mkdocs-material

original.statement: external-secrets 0.16.0 bumps the pinned mkdocs-material dependency used by the /hack/api-docs documentation tooling from 9.6.10 to 9.6.11, with no effect on the deployed operator.

decision.reason: [ev-7fa7364f4707] describes only a Dependabot bump of mkdocs-material from 9.6.10 to 9.6.11 inside the repository's /hack/api-docs documentation tooling. No deployed workload, chart value, CRD or image in a customer environment depends on it. The proposed undecidable exposure would mark every environment as possibly exposed, which is too broad. Whether someone builds the project's docs is not a customer environment state, and the condition vocabulary cannot express that no environment is exposed. So no valid applicability condition follows from the evidence.
